name: binance-to-influxdb
description: Binance to Influx is a container designed to be run on an (https://www.Unraid.net/) server via Docker. The purpose of the container is to simplify the ingestion of cryptocurrency market data, provided by the (https://binance.com/), into your own (https://www.influxdata.com/). The container collects the candles (klines) for each of the configured crypto symbols (e.g. BTCUSDT).
